entities.name: Dragon
entities.description: A creature type of huge, four-limbed, two-winged reptilians found across the multiverse, iconic to red.

entities.name: Ur-Dragon
entities.description: A multidimensional dragon avatar, native to no known plane, responsible for the Birth of the Elder Dragons on Dominaria.

entities.name: Elder Dragons
entities.description: The ancient dragons of Dominaria spawned directly by the Ur-Dragon; their war killed most of them and their winners became the ancestors of all dragons.

entities.name: Elder Dragon War
entities.description: The war among the Elder Dragons that shook Dominaria; winners became ancestors of dragons and drakes, losers became the land wurms.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An Elder Dragon and planeswalker, twin of Ugin, who told Malfegor to prepare an army and killed Ugin on Tarkir.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: An Elder Dragon who became a planeswalker before the war began and is characterized as a Spirit Dragon; his storms created Tarkir's dragons.

entities.name: Piru
entities.description: An Elder Dragon, lover of Chromium Rhuell, killed by Dakkon Blackblade.

entities.name: Chromium Rhuell
entities.description: An Elder Dragon who sired the Primeval Crosis with Piru.

entities.name: Vaevictis Asmadi
entities.description: An Elder Dragon, ancestor of the Shivan Dragons.

entities.name: Merrevia Sal
entities.description: An eighth Elder Dragon, killed shortly after her birth.

entities.name: Dakkon Blackblade
entities.description: A character who killed the Elder Dragon Piru in ages past.

entities.name: Primeval Dragons
entities.description: Five second-generation dragons who proclaimed themselves gods and ruled Dominaria until the Numena imprisoned them.

entities.name: Darigaaz
entities.description: A Primeval dragon reincarnated as a Shivan dragon, who rampaged during the Phyrexian Invasion and killed himself in a volcano.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A character who revealed the Primevals' existence to Rhammidarigaaz during the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A being who convinced Darigaaz of his folly.

entities.name: Malfegor
entities.description: The demon-dragon of Grixis who killed the archangel Asha in Bant and was killed by Elspeth and Rafiq.

entities.name: Asha
entities.description: An archangel of Bant killed by Malfegor.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who, with Rafiq, killed Malfegor in Bant.

entities.name: Rafiq
entities.description: A character who helped kill Malfegor in Bant.

entities.name: Sivitri Scarzam
entities.description: A planes-traveling being who used the Scarzam dragons to wage war on Corondor.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar
entities.description: A character who created a poisonous flower to destroy Sivitri's power.

entities.name: Founder Dragons
entities.description: Five dragons born of Arcavios's mana vortices who formed Strixhaven about 700 years ago and still watch over it.

entities.name: Dragon Spirits
entities.description: Five powerful serpentine kami of Kamigawa, one per color, who protected important mortal places.

entities.name: Yosei
entities.description: A Dragon Spirit who protected Eiganjo; reborn as Ao.

entities.name: Keiga
entities.description: A Dragon Spirit who protected Minamo and was killed by Hidetsugu; reborn as Kairi.

entities.name: Jugan
entities.description: A Dragon Spirit who protected Jukai forest; reborn as Kura.

entities.name: Ryusei
entities.description: A Dragon Spirit who guarded the Sokenzan mountains and brought back Jugan; reborn as Atsushi.

entities.name: Kokusho
entities.description: A Dragon Spirit guardian of Takenuma swamp; reborn as Junji.

entities.name: Ao
entities.description: The reborn form of Yosei.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: A character who killed Keiga with his yamabushi minions.

entities.name: Shivan Dragons
entities.description: Red and gold dragons of Shiv descended from Vaevictis Asmadi, bound into broods.

entities.name: Rorix Bladewing
entities.description: A Shivan dragon who died in the Grand Coliseum and was reanimated as Bladewing the Risen.

entities.name: Skithiryx
entities.description: A compleated dragon, pawn of Sheoldred.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A Phyrexian who affixed her torso to a dragon engine for the Battle of the Mana Rig.

entities.name: Rona
entities.description: A character seen piloting a dragon engine during the Second Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Dragon engines
entities.description: Dragon-like creatures of Phyrexia's first sphere, made by the original planeswalker who made Phyrexia and corrupted by Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: A Phyrexian who corrupted the dragon engines.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: A character who used dragon engines in the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Ramos
entities.description: A dragon engine construct worshipped as a god by the Cho-Arrim.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Parun of the Izzet League and last of Ravnica's intelligent dragons, who purged rivals long ago.

entities.name: Zomaj Hauc
entities.description: A character who tried to revive ancient dragon eggs on Ravnica.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: A character who foiled Zomaj Hauc's dragon-egg plot.

entities.name: Kalyntri
entities.description: A Shandalar dragon who ruled drakes near the Kapsho Sea until Talrand ended his rule.

entities.name: Talrand
entities.description: A hydromancer who ended Kalyntri's rule.

entities.name: Yinglong
entities.description: The primordial dragon of Shenmeng who gave birth to kirin, phoenixes and all hairy and flying creatures.

entities.name: Thraxes
entities.description: A powerful dragon of Theros to whom most dragon broods are linked.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker fascinated by dragons who traveled back in time to save Ugin and revive dragons.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: Female champion of Dromoka's Brood, revered by the Abzan Houses.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: Male champion of Ojutai's Brood, who took over the Jeskai and abolished the clan.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: Male champion of Silumgar's Brood, who made a pact with the Sultai.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: Female champion of Kolaghan's Brood, who became a fearsome leader of the Mardu.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: Female champion of Atarka's Brood, honored by the Temur Frontier.

entities.name: Tasigur
entities.description: Sultai khan who betrayed the other khans' meeting location to Silumgar.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: The ritual during which five additional Spirit Dragons appeared on Tarkir to help the clans defeat the Elder Dragons.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A plane whose dragons were born from Ugin's elemental storms.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the Elder Dragons were born and warred.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: The Shard of Alara where Malfegor was exiled.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane of the Dragon Spirits.

entities.name: Capenna
entities.description: A plane whose dragons were nearly all killed in the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Ziatora
entities.description: The Riveteers boss and the only Capennan dragon to survive the invasion.

events.summary: The Ur-Dragon is responsible for the Birth of the Elder Dragons on Dominaria.
events.quote: The Ur-Dragon is responsible for the Birth of the Elder Dragons on Dominaria

events.summary: Sivitri Scarzam uses the Scarzam dragons to wage war on Corondor.
events.quote: who used them to wage war on Corondor

events.summary: Malfegor kills the archangel Asha in Bant and is exiled to Grixis.
events.quote: he killed an archangel named Asha but was exiled to Grixis

events.summary: After the Mending, Nicol Bolas orders Malfegor to prepare an army against the other Shards.
events.quote: the elder dragon Nicol Bolas told Malfegor to prepare an army to attack the other Shards

events.summary: Malfegor is killed in Bant by Elspeth Tirel and Rafiq.
events.quote: he attacked Bant, where he was killed by Elspeth Tirel and Rafiq

events.summary: The Elder Dragon War shakes Dominaria and kills most Elder Dragons; winners become ancestors of dragons, losers become land wurms.
events.quote: the Elder Dragon War shook the plane of Dominaria and killed most of their kind

events.summary: Piru is killed by Dakkon Blackblade in ages past.
events.quote: Piru was largely forgotten after she was killed by Dakkon Blackblade in ages past

events.summary: Merrevia Sal is killed shortly after her birth.
events.quote: Merrevia Sal was killed in ages past

events.summary: The Primevals rule Dominaria as self-proclaimed gods until the Numena imprison them.
events.quote: They were self-proclaimed gods and once ruled Dominaria until the Numena managed to imprison them and steal their power

events.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion, Tevesh Szat reveals the Primevals to Rhammidarigaaz.
events.quote: Tevesh Szat revealed the existence of the Primevals to Rhammidarigaaz

events.summary: Karn convinces Darigaaz of his folly.
events.quote: until Karn convinced Darigaaz of his folly

events.summary: Darigaaz kills himself by plunging into a volcano, after which the other Primevals can be defeated.
events.quote: Darigaaz committed suicide by plunging into a volcano

events.summary: Keiga is killed by Hidetsugu and his yamabushi during their attack on Minamo's school.
events.quote: He was killed (if kami can be killed) by Hidetsugu and his yamabushi minions during their attack on the school

events.summary: Jugan is killed in the Battle of Silk but blesses the monks.
events.quote: He was killed but blessed the monks with power even after he was gone

events.summary: More than 1200 years after the Kami War the dragon spirits are reborn.
events.quote: the dragons have been reborn and continue to be the protectors of Kamigawa

events.summary: Rorix Bladewing dies in the Grand Coliseum and is reanimated as Bladewing the Risen.
events.quote: he was reanimated as Bladewing the Risen

events.summary: Darigaaz, a Primeval, is reincarnated as a Shivan dragon.
events.quote: The Primeval dragon Darigaaz was not originally a Shivan dragon, but was reincarnated as one

events.summary: Yawgmoth corrupts the dragon engines.
events.quote: Yawgmoth corrupted them

events.summary: Rona pilots a dragon engine and Sheoldred affixes her torso to one during the Second Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Sheoldred affixed her humanoid torso to a dragon engine for the Battle of the Mana Rig

events.summary: Zomaj Hauc tries to revive ancient dragon eggs on Ravnica but is foiled.
events.quote: Zomaj Hauc tried to revive several ancient dragon eggs some years after the Decamillennial

events.summary: Talrand ends the rule of the dragon Kalyntri.
events.quote: His rule was ended by Talrand when the dragon refused to submit to the hydromancer

events.summary: Nicol Bolas kills Ugin, ending the elemental storms and letting clans hunt Tarkir's dragons to extinction.
events.quote: Ugin's death at the hands of Nicol Bolas

events.summary: Sarkhan travels back in time, saving Ugin and reviving dragons.
events.quote: Sarkhan traveled back in time, bringing dragons back to life as he saved Ugin's life

events.summary: Each Tarkir clan surrenders to the dragonlords.
events.quote: Eventually, each of the clans surrendered to the dragonlords

events.summary: Ojutai has every ghostfire Jeskai warrior executed after taking over the Jeskai.
events.quote: Ojutai ordered the execution of every ghostfire Jeskai warrior

events.summary: Tasigur betrays the other khans' meeting place to Silumgar's brood.
events.quote: Tasigur betrayed the other khans by revealing the location of their meeting

events.summary: Five Spirit Dragons appear during the Stormnexus Ritual to help the recreated clans defeat the Elder Dragons.
events.quote: five additional Spirit Dragons appeared on Tarkir to help the recreated clans defeat the Elder Dragons
